editor.premise: An office-day routine built from early-morning preparation, a conversational makeup session, commuting, and settling into work.

chapters.name: Morning preparation
chapters.purpose: Establish the early start and turn preparation into small completed actions.

chapters.name: Makeup and conversation
chapters.purpose: Carry personal commentary through a routine, then reveal readiness to leave.

chapters.name: Commute
chapters.purpose: Compress the journey and move the story out of the apartment.

chapters.name: Office arrival
chapters.purpose: Establish the destination and begin the working portion of the day.

captions.note: Small white subtitles sit low during conversation; centered opening text, occasional activity labels, and isolated comic asides punctuate the routine.

editor.notes: Use one-second previews, then relax into longer speech beats. Compress repetitive actions with same-angle skips. Preserve brief mistakes and reaction pauses; reduced-size frames flag asides. Restore brisk music-led cutting for packing, finishing touches, and travel.
